{{Quote|Imperial walkers on the North Ridge.|A Rebel controller alerts Echo Base to the presence of AT-AT walkers during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''North Ridge''' was an area on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], located north of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. Starting just south of [[Mount Ison/Legends|Mount Ison]], the North Ridge stretched all the way to [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]] to the west, forming the northern edge of the [[Lanteel Glacier/Legends|Lanteel Glacier]]. It was the area that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and later, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] traversed shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
